The '''Tifnyl system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. An Imperial [[Listening post (Tifnyl)|listening post]] was based on the [[Tifnyl's moon|largest moon]] of the fourth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the system, the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Tifnyl]]. The [[Moon/Legends|moon]] was host to a thin [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and a primitive ecosystem.
